review.why: Reads, merges, splits, creates, OCRs and fills PDFs with pypdf, pdfplumber, reportlab and command-line tools.
review.summary: Cheat sheet for PDF work in Python and on the command line: extract text and tables, merge, split, rotate, watermark, password protection, OCR of scans, creating PDFs with reportlab (with a warning about subscript glyphs). Forms and advanced topics are in two companion files and several scripts.
strengths: Covers the everyday PDF tasks with working code
Warns about the reportlab subscript glyph trap
Quick-reference table maps each task to a tool
cautions: Tool by tool recipes; little help choosing a document structure
Needs several Python packages plus poppler and qpdf
Form filling and advanced usage live in files not read in this review
